findings.description: AWS access key and secret access key are hardcoded in plaintext within the user_data script, exposing long-term credentials to anyone with access to the instance metadata, console, or Terraform state.
Ingress rule opens TCP port 22 (SSH) to 0.0.0.0/0, allowing anyone on the internet to attempt SSH connections to the instance.
Ingress rule opens TCP port 80 to 0.0.0.0/0 with no additional controls, exposing the web server broadly; combined with unrestricted egress this widens the attack surface unnecessarily.
The EBS volume does not set encrypted = true, so data at rest on this volume is stored unencrypted.

findings.issue_category: missing encryption and public access controls
findings.description: The S3 bucket used to store VPC flow logs has no server-side encryption configuration and no public access block or bucket policy restricting access, risking unauthorized access to sensitive network traffic logs.
map_public_ip_on_launch is set to true, causing all instances launched in this subnet to automatically receive public IP addresses, increasing exposure to the internet.
map_public_ip_on_launch is set to true, causing all instances launched in this subnet to automatically receive public IP addresses, increasing exposure to the internet.
